es: Redactar una reclamación eficaz con hechos, tono firme y petición concreta, y una respuesta breve con disculpa, solución y plazo, cada una en un registro coherente.

teaching.en: I am writing to complain about the oven I bought on 3 March; it is faulty.
teaching.es: Escribo para quejarme del horno que compré el 3 de marzo; está defectuoso.
teaching.explanationEs: La reclamación abre con el motivo y un dato verificable: producto y fecha.

prompt.es: Elige la apertura más eficaz para una reclamación escrita.

choices.text: Hello, I hope you are well. I wanted to tell you a few things.
You never do your job properly, and I am furious.
I am writing to complain about the oven I bought on 3 March.

feedback.es: La buena apertura dice el motivo y da un dato verificable; las otras no informan o insultan.

hint.es: Dice el motivo de inmediato, sin insultos.

feedback.es: Unacceptable expresa firmeza en un registro formal, sin recurrir a insultos.

hint.es: Adjetivo formal que significa «que no se puede aceptar».

prompt.es: Ordena: «Espero que usted resuelva el problema esta semana.»

answer.text: I expect you to resolve the problem this week

feedback.es: Expect + objeto + to + verbo expresa una expectativa firme y formal.

hint.es: Empieza por I expect you to.

prompt.es: Escucha la respuesta de la empresa y elige qué ofrece.

choices.text: The full price back today.
A new product on Friday.
A discount on the next order.

feedback.es: Refund the full price significa devolver todo el dinero, y el plazo es hoy.

origin.audio: Thank you for contacting us. We are sorry about the delay, and we will refund the full price today.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase mantiene un tono firme pero controlado?

choices.text: This is the worst service ever, and you are useless.
I am disappointed, and I would be grateful if you could resolve this.
Whenever you have time, maybe you could possibly think about it.

feedback.es: Expresar la reacción y pedir una solución mantiene la firmeza; insultar o rogar con rodeos la pierde.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada palabra de la reclamación con su significado.

pairs.es: producto nuevo que sustituye al otro
dinero o ventaja por el daño

feedback.es: Son las palabras clave para describir el problema y pedir una solución.

prompt.es: ¿Qué rasgo rompe el registro formal de esta reclamación?

choices.text: The formal greeting.
The reply deadline.
The informal closing: Cheers!

feedback.es: Cheers! es un cierre informal que no encaja con Dear Sir or Madam ni con I would be grateful.

origin.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about a faulty oven. I would be grateful for a reply by Friday. Cheers!

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta de empresa es más formal y precisa?

choices.text: We will investigate the delay and respond within three days.
We will look into the delay and get back to you in three days.
We will sort the delay out and come back again in three days.

feedback.es: Investigate y respond son las opciones formales; la última, además, repite la idea con come back again.

prompt.es: Escucha esta reclamación y elige el diagnóstico de su tono.

choices.text: Stiff: too official for the situation.
Blunt: an order with no polite markers.
Warm: friendly and polite.

feedback.es: Dos órdenes secas y sin cortesía forman un mensaje brusco; habría que suavizarlo.

origin.audio: Give me my money back now. I will not wait.

prompt.es: Escribe la reclamación formal con hechos, tu reacción, una petición concreta y un plazo.

answer.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the oven I bought on 3 March. The delivery arrived two weeks late, and the oven is faulty. I was disappointed, because we needed it for a family dinner on Saturday. This delay is unacceptable, and I expect you to resolve it. I would therefore be grateful if you could arrange a replacement or a full refund by Friday. I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz
accepted: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to complain about the oven I bought on 3 March. The delivery arrived two weeks late, and the oven is faulty. I was disappointed, because we needed it for a family dinner on Saturday. This delay is unacceptable, and I expect you to resolve it. I would therefore be grateful if you could arrange a replacement or a full refund by Friday. I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz

Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing regarding the oven I bought on 3 March. It arrived two weeks late, and it is broken. I am disappointed, because we wanted to use it for a family dinner. Such a delay is unacceptable. I would be grateful if you could send a replacement or refund the full price by Friday. Kind regards, Carlos Ruiz

feedback.es: La reclamación ordena motivo, hechos, reacción, petición y plazo, en un registro formal sostenido.

origin.text: Compraste un horno el 3 de marzo. Llegó con dos semanas de retraso y está defectuoso. Tenías una cena familiar el sábado y te sentiste decepcionado. El retraso es inaceptable. Pide un horno nuevo o el reembolso completo antes del viernes. Tono formal y firme, con saludo y despedida.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta de la empresa incluye disculpa, solución y plazo?

choices.text: Thank you for writing. We will think about it.
We are sorry you feel that way. Please wait.
We apologise for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement by Friday.

feedback.es: La buena respuesta pide disculpas, ofrece una solución concreta y fija una fecha.

prompt.es: Completa: «Le ofreceremos una compensación por el retraso.»

feedback.es: Compensation es lo que la empresa ofrece para reparar el daño causado.

origin.text: We will offer you ___ for the delay.

prompt.es: Escribe la respuesta breve de la empresa a la reclamación de Carlos.

answer.text: Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for your message, and please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement oven by Friday, and we will offer you compensation for the delay. Please contact us if you need any further assistance. Kind regards, Customer Service
accepted: Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for your message, and please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement oven by Friday, and we will offer you compensation for the delay. Please contact us if you need any further assistance. Kind regards, Customer Service

Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for contacting us. We apologise for the delay and for the faulty oven. A replacement will be sent before Friday, and we will also offer you compensation. Kind regards, Customer Service

feedback.es: La respuesta agradece, se disculpa, da una solución con plazo y cierra con cortesía en el mismo registro formal.

origin.text: Responde como la empresa: agradece el mensaje, pide disculpas, ofrece un horno nuevo antes del viernes y una compensación, y cierra con un saludo formal.
